source.title: Feralas Mission I: Defeat Children of Cenarius
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Twin Colossals. Defeat maddened sons and daughters of Cenarius there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat 10 Lost Daughters and 10 Vengeful Sons in the Feralas Nightmare Incursion at the Twin Colossals and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
